native_authored_context.txtfile: On the creation of Obsidian Scale Weapon Ornament Molds:``First, a large block of magical clay must be infused with Dream Dust using a flask of water.``Once the Dream Infused Clay has been created, one to three pieces can be shaped using the desired sketch.``You will need to include a sample of hematite.``Finally, fire the mold using a sheet of the highest quality.^
